Thanks Daniel — appreciate the heads up.

Short answer: we can accept ACH, wire, or virtual card. Practical guidance below so AP can pick the cleanest path:

- ACH (preferred): standard US ACH to Redwood’s operating account. Clearing typically 2 business days after initiation.
- Wire: same-day credit if initiated before 16:00 PT (provide bank ref on payment).
- Virtual card: we can generate a one-time card link (fees apply; may be cheaper for you compared with expedited wire fees).
- Escrow option: we can accept remittance into an escrow (we provide instructions) if your procurement needs a neutral proof-of-funds window — slower but useful for special cases.

Outstanding tax item: if your finance team expects to withhold any WHT, please send the WHT certificate now (or confirm there is no withholding). If withholding applies, indicate the percentage and whether Novaterra will gross-up. For US entities typically no WHT is applied, but I’ll confirm with our tax team if you share the certificate.

Can you let me know which path AP will pick by EOD Tue (2026-10-19)? If you want, I can loop in Ben to create a virtual card or provide wire instructions today.

Best,
